role: Summer Internship, Advisor Platform Tech Ecosystem
jd:
Kestra Holdings offers industry-leading wealth management platforms for independent wealth management professionals nationwide. Kestra is dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients.

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact.

Do you want to get a preview of your career? Are you looking to get real-world experience in a fast-paced, growing organization? Do you want to be part of a collaborative environment? Are you excited to make an impact this summer?

Join the dynamic team at Kestra! Kestra Financial provides a leading independent advisor platform that empowers sophisticated, independent financial professionals, including traditional and hybrid RIAs, to prosper, grow, and provide superior client service. With a culture rich in reinvention and advisor advocacy, Kestra Financial has developed integrated business management technology that offers exceptional scale and efficiency combined with its personalized consulting services. Kestra Financial supports independent financial advisors in delivering comprehensive securities and investment advisory services to their clients.

Our '27 summer interns will impact on our company, teams, and advisors in many areas of our business units and functions. They will be part of a cohort of smart, ambitious, and curious contributors. Our internship program will run from the beginning of June through the end of July 2027. The '27 summer internship will be in our corporate office in Austin, TX, and in many of our member firms nationwide. Based on background and major, interns will be assigned to one of the following groups:

Kestra Groups:



- Client Service
- Compliance
- Operations
- Product/Data
- Finance
- Human Resources
- Marketing
- Legal
- Technology
- Investment Management

Our interns will work on key projects with specific goals and activities outlined by the leaders with whom they’ll work in their assigned groups. They will gain a more profound knowledge and understanding of the financial services industry, market insights and outlook, technology platforms, and how we provide services and support to our firms.

Our internship program is open to students from all backgrounds, and we strongly encourage those passionate about wealth management to apply. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all walks of life.

What You Bring:



- Minimum 3.0 GPA
- Preference, Undergraduate Juniors and Seniors
- AI Completed Course, Preferred 
- Microsoft Office suite: Should understand basic Excel, PowerPoint, and Word functions
- Highly motivated and driven individual
- Demonstrated ability to work well with teams
- Strong time-management capabilities
- Analytical and problem-solving individual with the ability to understand and interpret numeric
-  data
- Strong interpersonal skills and an interest in working in a client-service-oriented environment
- Basic knowledge and/or a keen interest in finance and a strong desire to gain further understanding of the wealth management business

Disclosure By applying to a job at Kestra Financial, Inc., you are agreeing to the following statements:



- You acknowledge that if hired, Kestra Financial, Inc. may, obtain and use background information concerning your credit, character, general reputation, personal characteristics, work habits, performance and experience for evaluation for your potential employment. 
- It is the policy of Kestra Financial to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Kestra Financial prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.
fit_why: Fintech internship; strong SWE overlap, but finance/wealth domain and unclear tech role

jd:
In this Role, You Will...:
• Use coding and analytical skills to derive insights that inform decisions and automation 

• Test new frameworks and algorithms to improve model performance 

• Work on a project such as drift monitoring, automated model retraining, predictive modeling, similarity search or statistical testing

Internship Requirements:
• Currently working towards a B.S., M.S., Ph.D., or advanced degree in data science, statistics, computer science, or a related engineering program 

• Good academic standing 

• Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028, and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship 

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox

Qualifications:
• Proficiency in Python and SQL 

• Coursework in machine learning, computer vision, or NLP 

• Familiarity with software-engineering practices such as Git, unit testing, debugging, and code reviews 

• Understanding of supervised learning, model evaluation, and common sources of dataset bias and label noise. 

• Experience with data analysis and visualization 

• Ability to communicate data clearly to different audiences

Bonus Qualifications:
• Experience with Databricks, Spark or cloud data tools 

• Experience with dashboarding or experiment design 

• Experience working with LLMs

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.
fit_why: Data science with ML and Python fits; autonomous-vehicle domain and degree requirements weaken it
